title: So I have made the master blueprint for a 2D pokergame. How much $$ would it cost to realise with Astra?
author: Brilliant_Feed4158
selftext:
With the help of ChatGPT I made a detailed description of the game, the platform I would like to build on and other specifications.

Its a 2D poker game. It'll use an engine for the poker. The biggest challenge will be creating an AI, but ChatGPT helped me outline the creation of the AI.

Now I'd like to build it using Astra. How much will it approximately cost? 

From what I've read Astra burns through tokens really fast. How many days would it take?

I understand it's impossible to precisely say with this limited information. But I'm looking for a solid guess. Thanks :)

comments.author: Ill-Past4609
comments.body: Just spend the $100 for the ChatGPT pro and see where it goes
